findings.label: Navratri day-1/festival palette overlap
findings.detail: navratri-day-1 (#C2185B->#7B1FA2) sits close to the original festival purple, and several festival entries reuse #E65100-family oranges. Palettes are distinct enough to be tasteful but not all unique. Cosmetic follow-up only.
